intent: Repair the mobile homepage hero so its crop shows less sky and its content leaves as one stable frame while scrolling.

visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: too much sky; scrolling is weird when things disappear and move

brief.visitor: A phone visitor evaluating Esteban's video services.
brief.promise: See the real filming scene, offer, price context, and next action without a distracting transition.
brief.primary_action: Choose a package or open WhatsApp.
brief.friction: Scroll-linked fading and movement made the hero appear broken.

kpi.decision_rule: retain if the stable hero remains usable and attributable inquiry data is later available

concept.idea: One stable camera frame on phone.
concept.visible_response: No fade, translate, black gap, or letterbox on phone scroll.
concept.alternatives: Do not change desktop composition or copy.

story.opening: Real filming scene with less empty sky.
story.action: Visitor scrolls or uses an existing action.
story.next_step: Choose a package or message Esteban.

references.avoid: Motion that makes readable content half-visible.

verification.rendered_states: 390x664 before and after 300px scroll; desktop unchanged.
verification.accessibility_performance: Existing actions and no horizontal overflow.
verification.conversion_boundary: Existing links only; no message sent.

learning.hypothesis: A stable hero removes visible friction without hiding the current path.
learning.decision_rule: retain if behavior passes and later inquiry measurement is available
learning.registration_condition: record comparable production events before outcome grading
